scope: Already-seen strict mechanical census; no model call, graph search, equation correction or original score change

grammar.grammar: Maximal physically contiguous standalone Move N: a op b = c or Step N: a op b = c lines, ASCII signed integer or fraction literals, operator + - * /. Require same label and numbering exactly 1..N; N <= min(5, input_count-1).
grammar.semantics: Replay literal equations in stated order from initial multiset using frozen apply_action with allow_fractions=False. Never correct, skip, reorder, search or execute candidate source. Every equation in whole block must be valid, including any after first target occurrence.
grammar.unsupported: Bullets, bold labels, bare numbered lines, decimals, Unicode operators, explanatory suffixes, blank-separated steps, inline/chained equations and other formats are unsupported or not detected; this does not imply reasoning lacks a solution.
grammar.offsets: Zero-based end-exclusive Python character offsets in retained reasoning; not tokens.
grammar.request_binding: SHA256 of exact retained request_start JSONL line bytes including newline; original HTTP request body not captured.
grammar.scope: Already-seen exploratory census, all 449 retained responses of direct/E2/E4/strong-solo; 292 length responses. Original metrics unchanged. No omitted response recovery.
grammar.baseline: Replay all 449 accepted-content fields independently and require agreement with retained verified reward.
grammar.evidence_policy: Exact extracted spans retained as audit evidence only, never used as future model input.

limitations: Unsupported/notdetected does not mean no solution in reasoning. Only standalone contiguous numbered Move/Step colon-equation lines are recognized.
Every equation in a block must validate; later invalid equations reject the whole block even if an earlier prefix reached target.
Offsets are zero-based Python string characters, never token offsets. No unobserved/censored responses can be recovered.
Request digest binds retained request_start metadata, not uncaptured HTTP request body.
Extracted evaluation solutions are audit evidence only and must not be copied into future Nemotron prompts.
